entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I bought some cycling shoes a while ago, and I think I need to return them. I'm not sure how it works, the website was a bit much for me.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a fit and preference issue?

Oh, I don't know if it's 'technical'. They just... they hurt. I keep getting these awful blisters on my heels whenever I ride. I thought it was the cleats, but I moved them around and it didn't help. I'm just so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can absolutely help you. Let me just pull up your order. I see it was delivered about 47 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, I think so. Does that mean it's too late? I knew I should have called sooner.

Not at all. Let me just confirm our policy... Okay, great news. Those shoes are a standard item, which means they fall under our 90-day return policy. You are well within the timeframe to send them back for a full refund.
Oh, really? A full refund? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was just stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course, I'm happy to get this sorted out for you. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid return shipping label. Just place the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
Okay, I think I can do that. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
